name: Gábor Kovács
bio:
Gábor's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying psychology at university in Budapest, he volunteered at a local karting track, initially just to earn extra credit. The roar of the engines and the competitive atmosphere captivated him. After graduation, he combined his degree with his newfound passion, landing a role in HR at a small engineering firm specializing in racing components. From there, he steadily climbed the ladder. 

Gábor believes in fostering a supportive and challenging environment where every team member can thrive. He's particularly adept at identifying and nurturing talent, a skill honed through years of observing team dynamics and understanding individual motivations. He's known for his innovative approach to recruitment, often looking beyond traditional qualifications to find individuals with the right attitude and potential.

At V8 Masters Racing, Gábor aims to build a team that's not only technically skilled but also deeply invested in the team's success. His ambition is to make V8 Masters Racing a place where people are excited to come to work every day, knowing they are contributing to something special.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Gábor is of average height, with a focused gaze and a confident demeanor.
